title: The canonical ringed tensor chain equals the strict quotient augmentation
statement: For the supplied RingedModels and any scheme X, its tensor chain natural transformation equals StrictTensorAugmentation.map. The full canonical pure-tensor and zero-shifted-coordinate normalization determines this transformation uniquely.

source.place: Tags 07A4 and 08TC; full strict tensor augmentation coordinate uniqueness.

proof.text: The first canonical clause supplies every homogeneous pure-tensor product coordinate. The second supplies the zero shifted coordinate. The strict augmentation has these same coordinates, and existsUnique_normalized identifies the natural transformations.
